name: PermissionKit
summary: Create communication experiences between a child and their parent or guardian.

declarations.name: AskCenter
declarations.comment:
A class that manages permission requests you send to parents or guardians for approval.

Use `AskCenter` to send permission questions to parents or guardians when a person needs approval for app
communication permissions or significant updates. The system routes your questions through the appropriate family sharing channels
and delivers responses back to your app when parents make their decisions.

Access the shared instance to send permission requests and register for response notifications. The system handles
the underlying communication with parents and manages the approval workflow automatically.

members.name: shared
members.comment:
The shared instance you use to send permission requests and receive responses.

Use this singleton instance to access all `AskCenter` functionality. The system maintains this shared instance
across your app's lifecycle and ensures consistent handling of permission requests and responses.

```swift
let center = AskCenter.shared
try await center.ask(permissionQuestion)
```

declarations.comment:

Obtain an `AsyncSequence` to handle communication permission responses after launching your app.

declarations.name: PermissionChoice
declarations.comment:
A class that uniquely identifies a specific, statically defined permission choice.

Each `PermissionQuestion` contains a set of possible answer choices,
each corresponding to a globally unique identifier that you can interpret.

`PermissionChoice` provides two predefined options for responding to permission requests:

```swift
let approveChoice = PermissionChoice.approve
let declineChoice = PermissionChoice.decline
```

Use these static properties to create responses to permission questions in your app.
You can interpret the context and meaning of each choice based on the specific
`PermissionQuestion` being answered.

```swift
public static let approve: PermissionChoice
public static let decline: PermissionChoice
```

declarations.name: SignificantAppUpdateTopic

members.name: init
members.comment:
Creates a new significant app update topic with the specified description.

Use this initializer to create a topic that describes significant changes to your app. The description you provide
helps people understand what changes you're making and why you need their consent.

- Parameter description: An explanation of the significant update that initiates this permission request.

members.name: description
members.comment:
A description of the significant update that initiates the permission question.

Provide a clear, concise explanation of what changes you're making to your app that require parental consent.
This description appears in the permission request that parents or guardians receive.

members.name: id
members.comment:
The unique identifier the system uses to categorize this topic type.

The system uses this identifier to group related permission requests and ensure your app receives responses
for questions with this topic. You don't need to modify this value - the system handles topic routing automatically
using this predefined identifier.
